claim.claim-text: 2. The assay device of claim 1 further comprising a buffer well (210) connected to the sample receiving area (213) via the capillary tube component (202).
3. The assay device of claim 2, wherein the depressible air chamber (206) is adapted to move a metered sample in the capillary tube component (202) into the buffer well (210).

4. The assay device of claim 2 or 3, wherein providing a buffer into the buffer well (210) provides a buffer in the buffer well (210), said buffer in the buffer well (210) mixes with the sample to provide a buffered sample, and said buffered sample contacts the lateral flow assay test strip (212) to initiate a lateral flow assay.
5. The assay device of any of claims 1 to 4, further comprising

6. The assay device of any of the previous claims, wherein the depressible air chamber (206) in an expanded state comprises air and the depressible chamber (206) in a depressed state displaces air into the capillary tube component (202) to move the sample to the buffer well (210).
7. The assay device of any of the previous claims, wherein the lateral flow assay test strip (212) comprises a labeled recombinant antigen; and an anti-human antibody.
8. The assay device of claim 7, wherein the anti-human antibody is immobilized on the lateral flow test strip (212).
9. The assay device of any of claims 1 to 6, wherein the lateral flow assay test strip (212) comprises a first antibody and a second antibody.
10. The assay device of claim 9, wherein the first antibody is immobilized on the lateral flow test strip (212) and the second antibody comprises a label.
12. The kit of claim 11 wherein the assay device (200A, 200B) is the assay device (200A, 200B) of any of claims 1 to 10.
13. The kit of claim 11 or 12 wherein the sample transfer device is a capillary tube, specimen dropper or pipette.
